notes: arsenal/media/edit.py + editapi.py: the editor's timeline document (arsenal.media.timeline/v0, one JSON file per project under <state>/edits/, one writer at a time by revision: a stale PUT gets 409 with the current document), pure clip operations (add, move, trim, split, remove, lane and per-track gain/mute/solo) that refuse overlaps on V1 and ranges past the media's end, and render(): one ffmpeg filter_complex over the clips (input-side seek, every stream anchored on src_in so late-starting tracks keep sync, timeline boundaries rounded to frames once, exact frame and sample counts per clip, per-track volume, amix, concat) encoded with an export preset, then audio.qc against the timeline's duration and the loudness target. Originals are never touched; renders land in a NEW folder <library root>/aurora-edits/<project>/ and never overwrite a file (the .part is claimed with O_EXCL, so two renders at once never share a name). HTTP: /api/edit/* inside py -m arsenal serve (import a dropped file by name+size, Range-served video and demuxed tracks, peaks, shots, keyframes, cutplan, projects, render jobs on one worker thread). CLI: py -m arsenal.media edit new|list|show|add|trim|split|move|rm|gain|render|lossless.
